title: feat(ui): chat answers link the filtered list they counted, and a link's filter is refused whole
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbVGdLod3jgo9RwZp8LsWiUj)_

Fixes #31869

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：AI 对话的回答现在可以用 `/list/OBJECT?view=…&uf__filter=…` 链接到"它数出来的那批记录"，点击后在控制台打开带筛选的列表；同时，列表链接里的筛选只要有一条条件指向读者看不到或对象未声明的字段，就整组拒绝，列表按视图本身打开并弹出提示。
- **为什么改**：卡 #31869（cloud#4087 的 `source.link` 需要它）。原先对话只认 `/record/OBJECT/ID`；而链接筛选遇到隐藏字段时只悄悄丢掉那一条，AND 下列表变宽、OR 下变窄，读者无从知晓。
- **风险与回滚**：链接的语法是封闭的，其他参数、重复、空值、片段一律不当作列表链接（照旧弹安全确认框），不转发原始 query。读者自己保存的列表状态仍按条丢弃，行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListUrlState.ts`（整组拒绝与提示）② `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/recordLink.ts`（`parseListLink` 封闭语法）③ `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`（`listLinkTarget` 由解析值重建地址）。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/chatRecordLink-13037.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.recordLink-13037.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.listUrlState-11860.test.tsx`，预期 3 个文件全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Chat list links** (`plugin-chatbot`): `recordLink.ts` adds `parseListLink` and `LIST_LINK_PATH_PATTERN` beside the record form. The form is `/list/OBJECT`, optionally with `view` (object-name grammar) and `uf__filter` (the Filter panel envelope `{ logic: and|or, conditions: [...] }`, at least one condition), each at most once and never empty. Anything else (another key, a repeat, an empty value, a fragment, a non-envelope filter, a further path segment) is not the list form and keeps streamdown's default link safety. `withRecordLinks` takes an optional list opener; `ChatbotEnhanced` takes a new optional `onOpenList` prop and provides it through `ListLinkContext`; `elements/message.tsx` reads it.
- **Host** (`AiChatPage.tsx`): `openList` resolves the app with `appOfObject` (the record opener's resolver) and navigates to `listLinkTarget(app, target)`, which builds `/apps/APP/OBJECT?view=…&uf__filter=…` from the parsed values only.
- **Whole-filter refusal for links** (`objectViewListUrlState.ts`): on the URL seed path, when the field gate or the spec's `ViewFilterRule` schema drops any condition the link's `uf__filter` carries, the whole filter is refused. The list opens on the view's own filter, the address bar loses `uf__filter`, and one `toast.warning` with the new key `console.objectView.linkFilterRefused` says why. The link's search, sort and grouping still apply. The stored-state seed keeps objectstack#28949's per-entry drop.
- **i18n**: `console.objectView.linkFilterRefused` in all eleven packs (zh-Hant by `gen:zh-hant`).

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/chatRecordLink-13037.test.tsx`: two new top-level describes, the list-link parse table (admitted and refused hrefs) and clicks (list opener called with the parsed target, no dialog; list and record links in one answer reach their own openers; an out-of-grammar key keeps the dialog; CONTROL with no list opener).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.recordLink-13037.test.tsx` (added to the surface by the seat): a new top-level describe with its own answer constant. A list-link click under a `/_console/` mount and a root mount lands on `/apps/com.acme.crm/opportunity` with exactly `view` and `uf__filter`, the filter equal to the link's. The record describe is unedited.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.listUrlState-11860.test.tsx`:
  - **Re-pinned (seat-approved)**: "a field the object no longer declares and an operator the spec does not know" and "a field this user cannot read …" move from the per-condition drop to the whole-filter refusal. Each now asserts that no list request carried any of the link's conditions (every query, not only the last), that the address lost `uf__filter`, and that the notice fired once; the second also pins permissions loaded at seed time and that the link's search still applies.
  - **New describe** "a link's filter is judged whole (objectstack#31869)": CONTROL all conditions pass (applied, no notice); an OR filter is refused whole too; CONTROL the reader's stored filter keeps its per-entry drop with no notice.
  - The stored-state drop pins (objectstack#28949) are unedited.
- **Ablation** (one, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): replacing `if (refusedLinkFilter) delete state.filters;` with a comment (back to the per-condition drop) turns the two re-pinned tests and the OR test red (3 failed / 31 passed); restored, blob identical to HEAD (`cbb3e1e7…`).

## Acceptance notes

- **No permission wait on the link seed** (seat ruling, amending claim 6736432372). Three readings: `isLoaded` has no loading-or-failed partner (`ui/packages/permissions/src/usePermissions.ts:48` answers `false` with no provider, `MePermissionsProvider.tsx:544` stays `false` after a failed read), so a wait could hang a link's list; the list mounts on `listPrefs.ready` alone (`objectViewListRenderer.tsx:374`), so a deferred seed would need a new pending gate; and the server's predicate guard refuses a hidden-field predicate with 403 (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/predicate-guard.ts`, "REJECT, never silently rewrite"), so in the load window the failure is loud, never a wider list.
- **Out of this PR**: `filter[FIELD]=v` on the object route stays equality-only and ungated on the client (the server answers 403 for a hidden field); `ObjectDataPage` drops a `filter[...]` predicate on an unreadable field with only a `console.warn`. Neither is the form cloud composes.
- **For cloud#4087**: compose `source.link` as `/list/OBJECT?uf__filter=` plus the percent-encoded `{"logic":"and"|"or","conditions":[{field,operator,value}…]}`, optionally `view=VIEW`. Operators are the spec's `ViewFilterRule` words, never `$` operators. Only a flat AND or OR of rules is expressible.
- A malformed `uf__filter` (not the envelope) still opens silently without a filter, as before; the notice covers a well-formed filter the checks cut.

## Verification

Head `da0a1b6e` (`origin/main` merged in; none of the 12 incoming commits touch these files, so there is no parallel same fix).

- **Touched pins, on the merged head after a `@objectstack/spec` rebuild**: the three test files above, 3/3 files, 51/51 tests.
- **By-hand suites (seat-ordered)**, `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 DIR` under the verify lock:
  - `packages/plugin-chatbot`: 95/95 files, 888 tests
  - `packages/i18n`: 100/100 files, 1843 passed, 13 skipped
  - `packages/app-shell/src/console`: 266/266 files, 2031 tests
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views`: 1489/1489 files, 13922 passed, 1 skipped (70 min on a shared box)
  - `ui/scripts` censuses with the list-URL pins: 173 files (171 passed, 2 skipped), 5061 passed
- **Type-check**: `turbo run type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`, 71/71 tasks green. ESLint on the touched files: 0 errors (warnings only, in families already present in those files).
- **Derived gates**: `dispatch-gates --commands`, 39 families, all exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 39 derived, 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:test-source-alias` first flagged the edited 11860 pin file, which reaches `celAuthoring`'s dynamic `@objectstack/lint` import, and passed once that file paid the load at module top. `check:type-check-debt` first answered 3 (queued behind this card's own suite run) and re-ran to 0.
- **Ablation**: see Tests. 3 failed, 31 passed with the per-condition drop put back; restored blob identical to HEAD.
- **Dogfood battery**: n/a. There is no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
